017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.http.response.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
023
024/**
025 * The action-envelope submit of a row job: {@code {action, targetId, idempotencyKey, fields}}, the shape the
026 * row-action dialog and the job-log card's {@code envelope: "action"} both send.
027 *
028 * <p>
029 * {@link #parse(JsonMap)} checks the shape; {@link #verify(JobKeyLedger, String, String)} checks the action, then the
030 * key's recorded binding.  The row identity is {@link #targetId()} plus that binding &mdash; never anything in
031 * {@link #fields()}, which is user-tamperable request data.  An endpoint that also carries the row id in its path
032 * should check {@code targetId().equals(pathId)} first.
033 *
034 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
035 * <p class='bjava'>
036 *    <jk>var</jk> <jv>submit</jv> = RowJobSubmit.<jsm>parse</jsm>(<jv>json</jv>);
037 *    <jk>if</jk> (! <jv>submit</jv>.targetId().equals(<jv>id</jv>))
038 *       <jk>return</jk> refuse(<jv>res</jv>, RowJobSubmit.<jsm>bindingRefusal</jsm>());
039 *    <jk>var</jk> <jv>grant</jv> = <jv>submit</jv>.verify(<jv>jobKeys</jv>, <js>"restock-species"</js>, <jv>actor</jv>);
040 *    <jk>if</jk> (<jv>grant</jv>.isEmpty())
041 *       <jk>return</jk> refuse(<jv>res</jv>, RowJobSubmit.<jsm>bindingRefusal</jsm>());  <jc>// answered 409</jc>
042 * </p>
043 *
044 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5>
045 * <ul>
046 *    <li class='jc'>{@link JobKeyLedger}
047 * </ul>
048 *
049 * @param action The submitted action id.
050 * @param targetId The submitted row id.
051 * @param idempotencyKey The submitted key value.
052 * @param fields The submitted fields; empty when the body omitted them.
053 *
054 * @since 10.0.0
055 */
056public record RowJobSubmit(String action, String targetId, String idempotencyKey, JsonMap fields) {
057
058   /** The HTTP status to answer {@link #bindingRefusal()} with. */
059   public static final int REFUSAL_STATUS = 409;
060
061   /**
062    * Parses the envelope.
063    *
064    * @param body The request body.
065    * @return The submit.
066    * @throws BadRequest On a non-object body, a blank {@code action}, {@code targetId} or {@code idempotencyKey}, or
067    *    a {@code fields} member that is not an object.  A missing {@code fields} reads as empty.
068    */
069   public static RowJobSubmit parse(JsonMap body) {
070      if (body == null)
071         throw new BadRequest("Expected a JSON object body");
072      var action = text(body, "action");
073      var targetId = text(body, "targetId");
074      var key = text(body, "idempotencyKey");
075      var f = body.get("fields");
076      JsonMap fields;
077      if (f == null)
078         fields = new JsonMap();
079      else if (f instanceof Map<?,?> m)
080         fields = new JsonMap(m);
081      else
082         throw new BadRequest("'fields' must be an object");
083      return new RowJobSubmit(action, targetId, key, fields);
084   }
085
086   private static String text(JsonMap body, String name) {
087      var v = body.get(name);
088      if (! (v instanceof CharSequence cs) || cs.toString().isBlank())
089         throw new BadRequest("Missing '%s'", name);
090      return cs.toString();
091   }
092
093   /**
094    * Checks the action, then the key's binding to {@code (action, targetId)}.
095    *
096    * @param ledger The ledger the key was issued from.
097    * @param expectedAction The action this endpoint performs.
098    * @return The grant, or empty when the action differs or the key does not verify.
099    */
100   public Optional<JobKeyLedger.Grant> verify(JobKeyLedger ledger, String expectedAction) {
101      if (! Objects.equals(action, expectedAction))
102         return Optional.empty();
103      return ledger.verify(idempotencyKey, action, targetId);
104   }
105
106   /**
107    * Checks the action, then the key's binding to {@code (action, targetId, principal)}.
108    *
109    * @param ledger The ledger the key was issued from.
110    * @param expectedAction The action this endpoint performs.
111    * @param principal The actor, resolved the same way the key endpoint resolved it.
112    * @return The grant, or empty when the action differs or the key does not verify.
113    */
114   public Optional<JobKeyLedger.Grant> verify(JobKeyLedger ledger, String expectedAction, String principal) {
115      if (! Objects.equals(action, expectedAction))
116         return Optional.empty();
117      return ledger.verify(idempotencyKey, action, targetId, principal);
118   }
119
120   /**
121    * The standard refusal for a failed verify; answer it with {@link #REFUSAL_STATUS}.
122    *
123    * <p>
124    * One code and one message for every kind of miss (see {@link JobKeyLedger}).
125    *
126    * @return A new refusal.
127    */
128   public static ActionResult bindingRefusal() {
129      return ActionResult.refusal(JobKeyLedger.REFUSAL_CODE).message("This key is not valid for this row.");
130   }
131
132   @Override /* Object */
133   public String toString() {
134      return "RowJobSubmit(action=" + action + ",targetId=" + targetId + ",idempotencyKey=<redacted>,fields=" + fields + ")";
135   }
136}
